title: NEET SS Seat Allotment Result 2025 for Round 2 releasing today at mcc.nic.in, here's how to check | Hindustan Times
text: The Medical Counselling Committee (MCC) will release the NEET SS Seat Allotment Result 2025 for Round 2 on August 13, 2026. The seat allotment result will be published at 11 am today. Candidates who have registered themselves for the counselling round can find the direct link through the official website of MCC at mcc.nic.in.Candidates who are allotted a seat can report to their allotted college from August 14 to August 20, 2026.O.P. Jindal online MSc in International Finance with ACCA pathway: Exemptions and careersCandidates allotted seats will be required to join the allotted college/course within the stipulated time from the date of allotment as mentioned in the counselling schedule. However, candidates are advised to join as early as possible and not to wait for the last day of joining, due to the different schedules of holiday/working hours in various Medical Colleges, also keeping in view that medical colleges will have to furnish information about joining/non-joining online to the Medical Counselling Committee. In some colleges, it takes 2 to 3 days to complete the admission formalities.How to check the seat allotment resultAll candidates who have registered for the counselling round can check the seat allotment result by following the steps below.1. Visit the official website of MCC at mcc.nic.in.2. Click on NEET SS Seat Allotment Result 2025 for Round 2 link available on the home page.3. A new page will open where candidates will have to enter the login details.4. Click on submit and your seat allotment result will be displayed.5. Check the result and download the confirmation page.6. Keep a hard copy of the same for further need.MCC NEET UG Counselling 2026: Round 1 registration ends, choice locking facility to open todayDocuments needed to join medical college Original documents required at the time of joining in allotted Medical College are as mentioned below:Provisional Allotment Letter issued by MCCAdmit Card issued by NBEResult/Rank Letter issued by NBEMBBS Degree Certificate/Provisional Certificate.MD/MS/DNB Degree Certificate in the concerned Specialty.Permanent Registration Certificate of MBBS/MD/MS/DNB issued by MCI/NMC or NBE/State Medical Council. Students who have completed/are completing post-graduation by 31st Jan, of the year of admission are eligible to apply with provisional certificate.High School/Higher Secondary Certificate/Birth Certificate as proof of date of birth to the allotted college at the time of admission.Tamil Nadu NEET UG Counselling 2026: Rank list for MBBS/BDS out at tnmedicalselection.net, direct links to check hereFor more related details candidates can check the official website of MCC.
